name: DSF
source: 261001 Rev B, CGF Topside DSF Fabrication Sequence (3 of 4 sheets in the file, issued for review 1 Oct 2026)

decks.name: Lower box L3-3, Lower box L3-4
Lower box L3-1, Lower box L3-2, Lower box L3-5…
Lower box L4-1, Lower box L4-2, Lower box L4-3…
Middle box M3-A, Middle box M3-C, Middle box M4-A…
Upper box U3-A, Upper box U3-C, Upper box U4-A…

steps.title: Fabrication of DSF parts
items: Prepare materials: cutting, beveling, rolling
Fabricate 24 DSF box parts in workshop (max 12 m per part), see DSF part list (row 3 shown, row 4 similar)
Fabricate main supports and temporary supports

steps.title: Layout supports
items: Layout main supports and temporary supports at final position
Survey & leveling check all supports

steps.title: Erect lower box row 3 (centre)
items: Lift & set lower parts L3-3, L3-4 on supports
Align, level and fit-up splice L3-3/L3-4, weld splice joint, NDT

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Lower box L3-3, Lower box L3-4

steps.title: Erect lower box row 3
items: Lift & set lower parts L3-2, L3-5 then L3-1, L3-6
Fit-up & weld splice joints, NDT
Dimensional check of lower box row 3

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Lower box L3-1, Lower box L3-2, Lower box L3-5, Lower box L3-6

steps.title: Install cross girders
items: Install cross girders CG-C (grid C) & CG-A (grid A) from row 3, free ends on temporary supports
Install transverse beams BR-2 & BR-3
Fit-up & welding at row 3, NDT

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Cross girders and transverse beams

steps.title: Install horizontal bracings
items: Install full horizontal bracings and gusset plates
Fit-up & welding at row 3 and bracing nodes, NDT
Survey row 4 connection points before setting lower box row 4

steps.title: Erect lower box row 4
items: Lift & set lower parts L4-3, L4-4 then L4-2, L4-5 then L4-1, L4-6
Fit-up & weld splice joints and connections to cross girders / bracings, NDT
Dimensional check of lower box row 3 & row 4

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Lower box L4-1, Lower box L4-2, Lower box L4-3, Lower box L4-4…

steps.title: Erect middle box
items: Lift & set middle parts M3-C1/C2, M3-A1/A2, M4-C1/C2, M4-A1/A2 on lower box
Fit-up & welding, NDT

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Middle box M3-A, Middle box M3-C, Middle box M4-A, Middle box M4-C

steps.title: Erect upper box
items: Lift & set upper parts U3-C, U3-A, U4-C, U4-A
Fit-up & welding, NDT

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Upper box U3-A, Upper box U3-C, Upper box U4-A, Upper box U4-C

steps.title: Install tubular frames
items: Install tubular frames TF-C (grid C) & TF-A (grid A)
Fit-up & welding, NDT

steps.title: Install DSF support
items: Install DSF support DSU-3.1 on row 3
Complete welding & NDT, final dimensional control
Touch-up and final painting

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: DSF support DSU-3.1

steps.title: Install timbers
items: Remove temporary supports
Jack up DSF, remove packings, install timbers, clip plates & bolts, lower DSF onto main supports
Ready for weighing / load-out

actions.label: Fabricate and fit: Timbers, clip plates and bolts
